_comment: Deterministic age = max(rating_floor[rated], category_floor[category][severity]) + stacking bumps. Edit numbers here, push, and the site rebuilds without refetching. Ratings not listed (N/A, Not Rated, Approved, Passed) contribute no floor, so the Parents Guide alone decides. Calibrated against: Totoro/Ponyo/Prince Achmed = 3; Kiki/Penzance/Chipmunk Adventure/Up/Iron Giant/WALL-E/Muppet Treasure Island = 4.

stacking._comment: Optional bumps when several categories are heavy at once. Set counts to 0 to disable.
